title: Someone Is Choking: What to Do in the First Minute (Part 1/5)
description_top:
Choking first aid for adults, children and babies: the warning signs, back blows and abdominal thrusts, step by step.
Learn what to do in the first minute, when to call 911, and the common mistakes that make choking worse.
pin_question: Have you ever had to help someone who was choking, or had a scary choking moment yourself? What happened?

title: Cold Can Kill: Hypothermia Signs Most People Miss (Part 2/5)
description_top:
Hypothermia and frostbite symptoms, warning signs and first aid for cold weather, explained simply.
Learn who is most at risk, what to do while you wait for help, and how to stay warm and safe this winter.
pin_question: Have you or someone you know ever been stuck out in the cold longer than planned? What helped you stay warm?
